reviewCommentLibrary.label: Opening review note
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Starting controlled review. I am checking private repo visibility, no-live-data boundary, issue trace, evidence links, branch protection proof, no-secret proof, rollback, and closeout owner before any approval.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Approve lane
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Approved for my lane. Evidence is linked, issue trace is visible, rollback is clear, and no-live-data/no-secret/no-commercial-export boundaries are preserved.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Evidence hold
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Holding approval until the named evidence file, command output, screenshot, workflow name, issue URL, or owner response is complete and linked in the PR body.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Request changes
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Requesting changes because a trust blocker is present or unresolved: public visibility, secret, workbook, commercial leak, no rollback, unsafe branch posture, missing owner, or missing proof.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: No-leak signoff
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: No-leak signoff: no customer workbook, production secret, certificate, payment key, invoice, billing export, or commercial tracker value is approved in this PR.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Deferred proof
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Deferred proof is acceptable only when the blocker note names the missing proof, owner, reason, target date, and next command or screenshot needed to close it.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Branch protection hold
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Holding branch-protection approval until the exact GitHub Actions check names are known from a real workflow run. Required checks must not be guessed.

reviewCommentLibrary.label: Merge closeout
reviewCommentLibrary.comment: Merge can proceed only after all reviewer lanes are green, required checks are exact, branch protection is documented, no-leak proof is linked, rollback is written, and next owner is named.

reviewerCommentPackets.comment:
Reviewer lane: Founder / Product
Scope: Scope owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only for product scope, no-live-data boundary, first PR intent, issue trace, rollback, and next owner visibility.
Hold with a named owner and proof file when evidence is incomplete.
Request changes for trust blockers.

Reviewer lane: Platform owner
Scope: Repo owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only after private visibility, workflow names, branch discipline, branch protection timing, and rollback are visible.
Hold if check names are guessed or repo proof is missing.
Request changes for public visibility or direct main push.

Reviewer lane: Backend lead
Scope: Code owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only after folder shell, API starter files, package boundaries, commands, tests, and transcript proof are visible.
Hold if implementation proof is placeholder-only.
Request changes for unsafe route or missing guard structure.

Reviewer lane: Security owner
Scope: Control owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only after no-secret proof, tenant guard, commercial privacy, denied-audit proof, and no-workbook boundary are visible.
Request changes for any credential, workbook, public repo, or commercial leakage.

Reviewer lane: Data owner
Scope: Migration owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only after generated fixtures, source trace, rollback, import dry-run, quarantine, and no workbook import are visible.
Hold if fixture or migration evidence is incomplete.

Reviewer lane: QA / Release
Scope: Release owner
Default action: COMMENT until evidence is linked.
Approve only after evidence files, screenshots, workflow proof, branch rules, closeout readiness, and next owner are visible.
Hold if closeout is missing or checks are not exact.

inlineCommentSnippets.title: No-secret proof

Evidence hold / PR conversation / COMMENT
Holding approval until the named evidence file, command output, screenshot, workflow name, issue URL, or owner response is complete and linked in the PR body.

Request changes / Formal review / REQUEST_CHANGES
Requesting changes because a trust blocker is present or unresolved: public visibility, secret, workbook, commercial leak, no rollback, unsafe branch posture, missing owner, or missing proof.

No-leak signoff / Security note / COMMENT
No-leak signoff: no customer workbook, production secret, certificate, payment key, invoice, billing export, or commercial tracker value is approved in this PR.

Deferred proof / PR conversation / COMMENT
Deferred proof is acceptable only when the blocker note names the missing proof, owner, reason, target date, and next command or screenshot needed to close it.

Branch protection hold / PR conversation / COMMENT
Holding branch-protection approval until the exact GitHub Actions check names are known from a real workflow run. Required checks must not be guessed.

Merge closeout / PR closeout / COMMENT
Merge can proceed only after all reviewer lanes are green, required checks are exact, branch protection is documented, no-leak proof is linked, rollback is written, and next owner is named.
handoff: v140 turns the backend PR review gate matrix into copy-ready GitHub PR review comments.
The pack separates neutral comments, lane approvals, request-changes blockers, no-leak signoffs, evidence holds, branch-protection holds, and merge closeout language.
The static demo still cannot post to GitHub; it now gives the exact language to paste once the real private PR exists.
v141 can now prepare the private repo evidence closeout pack for passed, held, blocked, deferred, rollback, no-leak, and next-owner outcomes.
